Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Assistant Government Pleader for the respondents.

This writ petition was filed questioning the action of the respondents in not acquiring the petitioner's land admeasuring 0.62 cents along with structure (0.57 cents of land and structure covering 0.5 cents) in Sy.No.492/1 of Cherlopalle village, Owk Mandal, Nandyal District though the same was taken possession for the purpose of Owk reservoir in 2015 itself and except the correspondence no steps are taken to initiate land acquisition proceedings under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
